title: Nutty Brazilian Buckwheat Empanadas
description: A kid-friendly Brazilian dish featuring buckwheat flour and nuka-pickle, served in a scallop shell vessel, this vegan-friendly recipe is perfect for a snack or lunch.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine buckwheat flour, nuka-pickle, salt, and sugar.
Add melted vegan butter and water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place it into a scalloped shell.
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes or until they are golden brown.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the empanadas warm and enjoy.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
